what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cuba in Spain: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4205 Cuban asylum seekers in Spain, 1.5% of all asylum seekers from Cuba.
Refugees from Cuba, a separate group, live mostly in Mexico, the United States, Costa Rica and Paraguay.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Cuba, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 185 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5550, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Spain only.
